parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested in human assays against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require compound_structures as an inner join. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
